framework.name: Open Extended Jungian Type Scales 1.2
framework.description: Thirty-two bipolar pairs put two descriptions at the ends of a five point scale, eight pairs per dichotomy. Each answer is scored 1-5 from the left description to the right one; the eight pairs of a dichotomy are averaged after reversing the pairs the source keys negatively, which reproduces the published sum exactly. The published cut of 24 of 40 points is therefore an average of 3.0: above it reads Extroversion, Intuition, Thinking or Perceiving, below it reads the opposite pole. Read the four letters together for the type, for example I, S, F, P gives ISFP.
framework.citation: Jorgenson, E. (2015). Open Extended Jungian Type Scales 1.2. openpsychometrics.org/tests/OEJTS/

traits.name: Extroversion
traits.description: Extroversion over Introversion, the IE scale. Published sum: 30 - Q3 - Q7 - Q11 + Q15 - Q19 + Q23 + Q27 - Q31, read as Extroversion above 24 of 40.

traits.name: Intuition
traits.description: Intuition over Sensing, the SN scale. Published sum: 12 + Q4 + Q8 + Q12 + Q16 + Q20 - Q24 - Q28 + Q32, read as Intuition above 24 of 40.

traits.name: Thinking
traits.description: Thinking over Feeling, the FT scale. Published sum: 30 - Q2 + Q6 + Q10 - Q14 - Q18 + Q22 - Q26 - Q30, read as Thinking above 24 of 40.

traits.name: Perceiving
traits.description: Perceiving over Judging, the JP scale. Published sum: 18 + Q1 + Q5 - Q9 + Q13 - Q17 + Q21 - Q25 + Q29, read as Perceiving above 24 of 40.
